problem: Asset acquisition transaction/lifecycle activities (specify, procure, receive, commission, capitalise) are overloaded onto the asset identity aggregate.
required_outcome: Separate governed acquisition/procurement/commissioning process identities while preserving canonical Asset identity and provenance.

problem: Construction / Project Delivery design, permit, construct, inspect, commission and handover activities are represented as property acquisition.
required_outcome: Map project delivery to Project/Work Package/Information/Inspection/Commissioning/Handover aggregates with Asset/Property as context or outcome.

problem: Operational/legal lease identity, obligations, renewals and termination are conflated with accounting measurement.
required_outcome: Establish canonical Lease/Occupancy/Property-interest identity separate from lease-accounting measurement and postings.

problem: Disposal must not destroy canonical asset history.
required_outcome: Replace deletion semantics with retire/dispose/decommission/effective-end lifecycle while retaining immutable history and evidence.

problem: Safety framework, hazard assessment, inspection, incident, occupational health and permit-to-work are materially different governed objects but share one incident aggregate/object family.
required_outcome: Define linked but distinct H&S policy/framework, hazard/risk assessment, inspection, incident, occupational-health and permit aggregates/objects.

problem: Occupational-health/surveillance information can contain sensitive worker health data and cannot share ordinary incident/permit access and retention semantics.
required_outcome: Create dedicated occupational-health record boundary with purpose-limited access, retention, audit and disclosure controls.

problem: Carbon accounting, energy management, sustainability strategy and ESG disclosure have different truth, lifecycle and assurance semantics.
required_outcome: Separate or explicitly model linked Carbon, Energy, Sustainability Strategy and ESG Disclosure/Reporting objects while retaining shared metrics where appropriate.

problem: Environmental aspects/impacts/controls and environmental compliance obligations are conflated.
required_outcome: Model environmental management/aspects/impacts/controls separately from external compliance requirements, permits, returns and findings.

problem: Financial strategy, budgeting, rolling forecast, commercial profitability and capital-investment approval are different governed truths but share one broad object.
required_outcome: Separate Budget, Forecast, Financial Planning/Scenario, Profitability Analysis and Capital Investment Request/Approval objects with controlled relationships.

problem: Ledger postings, close process, consolidation, financial-report outputs and control certification have different lifecycle/evidence semantics.
required_outcome: Keep immutable ledger truth separate from Close, Consolidation Run, Reporting Snapshot/Statement and Financial Control/Certification objects.

problem: Cash positions, bank accounts, payment runs, FX exposures/hedges and debt facilities/covenants are materially different treasury objects.
required_outcome: Define linked treasury objects for Cash Position/Bank Account, Payment Run/Instruction, FX Exposure/Hedge and Debt Facility/Covenant.

problem: Capex request, evaluation, approval, spend tracking and benefits review are treated as fields/actions on a budget object.
required_outcome: Create a governed Capital Investment Request/Decision lifecycle linked to Budget, Project/Asset, Decision and Ledger outcomes.

current_model: Journal post; Payment create/approve/transmit; Financial control certification
problem: The activity catalogue does not by itself prove maker-checker, journal approval, payment segregation or control-certifier independence.
required_outcome: Model explicit authority and SoD policies for journal preparation/approval/posting, payment preparation/approval/transmission, reconciliations and control certification.

current_model: AGG-03-ACCOUNT-PLAN / Sales / Account Plan / Account / Partner Plan
problem: Enterprise sales strategy/territories/quotas, customer account plans, partner plans and sales-performance outcomes have different lifecycle and subject semantics.
required_outcome: Separate Sales Strategy/Territory/Quota, Account Plan, Partner Plan and Sales Performance Snapshot concepts while preserving shared customer/party references.

problem: Individual opportunity truth, pipeline aggregation and sales forecast/scenario are conflated.
required_outcome: Keep Opportunity as transactional truth; model Pipeline and Sales Forecast as governed aggregate/snapshot/scenario views with explicit as-of/version semantics.

problem: Sales incentive definition, commission calculation and payment approval require explicit maker/checker and payroll/finance handoff semantics.
required_outcome: Define compensation-plan versioning, calculation run, exception approval and payment-authority separation linked to payroll/finance.

problem: Procurement strategy, category planning and procurement analytics are different governed outputs but share one package object.
required_outcome: Separate Procurement Strategy, Category Plan and Procurement Analytics/Snapshot semantics while linking them to sourcing packages/events.

problem: Supplier discovery, due diligence/onboarding/activation and ongoing relationship management are distinct lifecycle processes but share a generic relationship object.
required_outcome: Model Supplier Candidate/Qualification, Onboarding/Due-Diligence Case and Supplier Relationship separately while retaining one canonical Party/Organisation identity.

problem: Requisition conversion and PO approval/issue must preserve distinct requester/buyer/approver authority and commitment thresholds.
required_outcome: Define explicit procurement authority/SoD policy, approval thresholds and immutable commitment issue/amendment history.

problem: Risk framework/taxonomy/appetite/methodology and individual risk identification/assessment/treatment/monitoring are different governed concepts.
required_outcome: Separate Risk Framework/Taxonomy/Appetite from Risk Record, Assessment, Treatment Plan and Monitoring/KRI evidence while keeping one linked risk domain.

problem: External obligations, internal interpretation, compliance assessment/attestation, breach/exception and remediation are conflated.
required_outcome: Separate Compliance Requirement/Obligation from Assessment/Attestation, Breach/Exception and linked Remediation evidence.

problem: Control definition/ownership/execution and individual design/operating-effectiveness tests/deficiencies share one object family without explicit immutable test-run evidence.
required_outcome: Model Control identity separately from Control Execution/Test Run, Sample, Evidence and Deficiency with tester independence and point-in-time results.

problem: Audit universe/plan, audit engagement/workpapers/findings/report and enterprise assurance coordination are materially different objects.
required_outcome: Separate Audit Universe/Plan, Audit Engagement, Workpaper/Evidence, Finding, Report and Assurance Map/Provider while preserving traceability.

problem: Remediation can originate from risk, compliance, controls, audit, quality, safety or other domains and must not be owned only by Audit.
required_outcome: Create cross-domain Finding/Issue/Remediation semantics with source provenance, action ownership, due dates, verification and closure evidence.

problem: Fraud scenario assessment and suspected-fraud investigation are different; investigation requires restricted case/evidence handling.
required_outcome: Separate Fraud Risk/Scenario from restricted Fraud Investigation Case with evidence, participants, legal hold/access and disposition.

problem: Declarations, conflicts of interest, gifts/hospitality and whistleblowing are cases/registers, not compliance requirements.
required_outcome: Define Ethics Declaration, Conflict, Gifts/Hospitality and restricted Speak-Up/Whistleblowing Case objects linked to policy/requirements.

problem: Job Profile assignment alone cannot prove auditor independence, reviewer separation or assurance-provider conflicts.
required_outcome: Model independence/conflict/assignment rules separately from access permissions and retain attributable review/approval evidence.

problem: Legal advice, regulatory advice, employment matters and legal spend share one Legal Matter object without explicit privilege/confidentiality/matter-team/external-counsel controls.
required_outcome: Model Legal Matter with privilege/confidentiality classification, matter team, client/business owner, external counsel, spend/engagement references and restricted evidence access.

problem: Legal entity establishment/registration and board governance/resolutions/statutory books are distinct governed truths.
required_outcome: Separate Legal Entity/Registration records from Board/Committee Governance, Resolution and Statutory Register/Book records while linking them.

problem: Contract lifecycle, extracted contract obligations/milestones and enterprise legal obligations are not explicitly differentiated.
required_outcome: Model Contract Obligation/Milestone separately from Contract identity and Legal/Regulatory Obligation, with source clause/version provenance.

problem: Legal hold, preservation, search/collection and disclosure are distinct from ordinary retention/disposition policy.
required_outcome: Model Legal Hold as a preservation override linked to custodians/sources/records; model collection/review/disclosure evidence separately and enforce hold precedence over disposition.

problem: Proceeding identity and litigation evidence/work product need restricted provenance and disclosure controls.
required_outcome: Separate Proceeding/Dispute identity from evidence collection, legal work product, settlement authority and disclosure/production records.

problem: Record of Processing Activity and DPIA are different governed records with different triggers, approvals and lifecycle.
required_outcome: Separate Processing Activity inventory from DPIA/Privacy Risk Assessment, linking assessment to the exact processing version and controls.

problem: International-transfer assessment, transfer mechanism/safeguards and decision evidence are not merely processing/DPIA fields.
required_outcome: Define International Transfer/Transfer Assessment with countries, recipients, mechanism, safeguards, supplementary measures, review dates and decision evidence linked to processing.

problem: Identity verification, search, redaction/exemption review, response and disclosure need purpose-limited case evidence and deadline provenance.
required_outcome: Model rights request case stages, identity-verification evidence, search/source results, exemptions/redactions, response package and statutory clocks separately.

problem: Breach assessment, containment, investigation and regulator/data-subject notification decisions require point-in-time risk and decision evidence.
required_outcome: Model incident facts, affected data/subjects, risk assessment, containment actions, notification decision, notifications and closure evidence with restricted access.

problem: Privacy retention/destruction, records schedules and legal holds cross functions but precedence is not explicit.
required_outcome: Create one governed retention/disposition policy model with legal/regulatory hold overrides, source-record classification, approval, destruction evidence and exceptions.

problem: Continuity framework, BIA, continuity plan, exercise/test and disaster-recovery invocation are distinct objects with different versions/evidence.
required_outcome: Separate Continuity Framework, BIA, Continuity Plan, Exercise/Test, Recovery Plan/Invocation and Recovery Validation while linking critical services/dependencies.

problem: Crisis event/activation, emergency operational response and crisis communications share one object.
required_outcome: Separate Crisis/Event, Response Activation/Action Log, Emergency Accountability/Evacuation evidence and Crisis Communication/Approval records.

problem: Physical access/security events, visitor passes, restricted investigations and travel-risk/traveller tracking are materially different governed records.
required_outcome: Separate Physical Security Event, Visitor/Access Pass, Restricted Security Investigation and Travel Risk/Traveller Assistance records.

problem: The source activities are Visitor Management only; the generated title is broader than the work.
required_outcome: Use Visitor Management Coordinator as the V3 employment title while retaining F24.10 provenance.

current_model: Security Investigations on physical-security incident aggregate
problem: Allegations, interviews and evidence require restricted investigation-case access, legal/HR handoffs and evidence integrity.
required_outcome: Create restricted Security Investigation Case with allegation, subjects, investigators, evidence, interviews, findings, legal/HR referrals and disposition.

problem: Knowledge strategy/governance/platform decisions are not Knowledge Articles.
required_outcome: Model Knowledge Strategy/Governance separately from Knowledge Content/Article/Collection.

current_model: Knowledge Capture includes procedures; Controlled Documents uses Information Container
problem: A captured knowledge article must not become an uncontrolled duplicate of an authoritative controlled procedure.
required_outcome: Link knowledge/expertise content to the authoritative controlled document where applicable; only the controlled-information lifecycle may issue official procedures.

problem: Generic document management and controlled-document issue/withdrawal use the same object without explicit controlled status/effectivity/distribution semantics.
required_outcome: Define controlled-information lifecycle states, revision/effectivity, approval basis, distribution/acknowledgement and supersession on Information Container or a governed overlay.

problem: Record/file identity, classification, retention schedule, hold and disposition are bundled together.
required_outcome: Separate Record/Record Series from Retention Schedule, Hold/Exception, Disposition Decision and Disposition Certificate while preserving immutable provenance.

current_model: Enterprise Search activity includes manage permissions
problem: Search/index administration must not become an independent authorization authority that can expose source content.
required_outcome: Search must inherit/evaluate source-system authorization at query/result/content access; index metadata must be security-trimmed and permission changes owned by authoritative access controls.

problem: Disposition must prove authorization, hold checks, scope and completion without deleting the evidence that disposal occurred.
required_outcome: Retain immutable disposition decision/certificate/audit evidence after content destruction, with legal/privacy hold checks and subject scope.

problem: People strategy, workforce plan and organisation design/reporting structures are different governed objects.
required_outcome: Separate People Strategy, Workforce Plan/Scenario and Organisation Structure/Org Unit design while linking them to approved Positions.

problem: Job Profile and Position are distinct concepts but share one object label.
required_outcome: Model Job Profile as reusable employment definition and Position as tenant/org-specific seat with effective dates, reporting line, scope and assignments.

problem: Vacancy/requisition, candidate/application, screening/checks, offer and onboarding are distinct governed records.
required_outcome: Separate Vacancy/Requisition, Candidate/Application, Screening Case, Offer and Onboarding Plan while linking to Position and Worker Relationship.

problem: Worker master/relationship, employee-relations cases and offboarding cases have different privacy/access and lifecycle semantics.
required_outcome: Keep Worker Relationship master separate from restricted Employee Relations Case and Offboarding/Termination Case, with effective-dated Position assignment.

problem: Payroll calculation/payment, compensation structures/awards and benefit enrolments are different governed truths.
required_outcome: Separate Payroll Run/Result, Compensation Plan/Range/Award and Benefit Plan/Enrollment with finance/payment handoffs.

problem: Absence management may include sensitive health information that must not share unrestricted timesheet access.
required_outcome: Separate absence case/reason evidence with purpose-limited access from ordinary time/attendance transactions.

problem: Technology strategy, enterprise architecture and solution architecture are distinct artifacts/decision records.
required_outcome: Separate Technology Strategy/Roadmap, Enterprise Architecture model/standards and Solution Architecture/Decision records.

problem: Applications, software components, environments, infrastructure, cloud subscriptions, networks, endpoints, IT assets and capacity metrics are over-compressed.
required_outcome: Define canonical Technology Service/Application, Component, Environment, Infrastructure Resource, Network, Endpoint/Device and IT Asset identities with relationships.

problem: Identity administration can assign access directly, conflating identity lifecycle with approved access authority.
required_outcome: Separate User Identity/account lifecycle from Access Request/Approval/Grant; provisioning must execute an approved grant and cannot create authority.

problem: Change request, release/package/deployment and configuration item/baseline are different governed objects.
required_outcome: Separate Technology Change, Release/Deployment and Configuration Item/Baseline with exact affected-version relationships.

problem: Recovery requirements/plan, backups/replication, test execution and restoration evidence are conflated.
required_outcome: Separate DR Plan, Recovery Requirement, Backup/Replication evidence, Recovery Test and Recovery Invocation/Result.

problem: Technology vendor selection/licensing/contracting must reuse canonical supplier/procurement/contract truth rather than create an IT-owned supplier/contract silo.
required_outcome: Reference Party/Supplier, Sourcing/Procurement and Contract aggregates; IT owns technology requirements/service performance, not duplicate supplier identity.

problem: Data strategy, governance ownership/policy and architecture/models/flows are distinct governed outputs.
required_outcome: Separate Data Strategy, Data Domain/Ownership/Governance and Data Architecture/Lineage Model while linking them.

problem: Dataset/data product identity, platform infrastructure, catalogue metadata and lifecycle policy are conflated.
required_outcome: Separate Data Product/Dataset, Data Platform Resource, Catalogue/Metadata/Lineage and Lifecycle/Retention policy semantics.

problem: Published BI reports, analytical studies/scenarios and trained statistical/data-science models are different governed artifacts.
required_outcome: Separate Report/Dashboard, Analysis/Scenario and Analytical Model/Model Version/Evaluation.

problem: AI use case, system/model/version, risk assessment/approval and operational deployment/monitoring are different governed objects.
required_outcome: Separate AI Use Case/System, Model/Version, Evaluation, Governance Assessment/Approval and Deployment/Monitoring records.

problem: Data access approval/provisioning risks becoming a separate authorization system.
required_outcome: Data Access Request must resolve to approved scoped Access Grants enforced by the common identity/authorization service; data teams cannot bypass enterprise authority.

problem: Dataset deletion/disposal must honour privacy, records and legal holds with immutable evidence.
required_outcome: Apply common retention/hold/disposition precedence and retain disposition provenance for data products/datasets.

problem: Security strategy, policy/standard and security architecture/control design are different governed artifacts.
required_outcome: Separate Security Strategy/Roadmap, Policy/Standard and Security Architecture/Control Pattern/Exception.

problem: Authentication, authorization, privileged access and access reviews must not create a second authority model separate from enterprise IAM/access grants.
required_outcome: Use common User Identity, Access Request/Grant, Privileged Access and Review/Certification semantics with explicit delegated authority.

problem: Vulnerability finding, patch/advisory, application-security finding and remediation/verification are different records.
required_outcome: Separate Vulnerability/Finding, Patch/Advisory, Remediation Action and Verification/Test Result with asset/component/version linkage.

problem: Operational alerts, threat intelligence/indicators and penetration-test engagements/findings are materially different.
required_outcome: Separate Security Event/Alert/Case, Threat Intelligence/Indicator and Security Test/Pentest Engagement/Finding.

problem: Keys/certificates/encryption policies are not access grants and require dedicated lifecycle/custody semantics.
required_outcome: Define Cryptographic Key/Certificate/Trust relationship with custody, rotation, expiry, revocation and HSM/provider provenance.

problem: Purpose/vision/mission, enterprise strategy, annual business plans and operating model are distinct governed Work Products but share one broad object.
required_outcome: Separate Purpose/Vision/Mission, Strategy, Business Plan/Initiative and Operating Model/Capability/Accountability objects with explicit lineage and effective dating.

problem: Governance body, meeting, board/committee pack, minutes, resolution and action are different governed records.
required_outcome: Separate Governance Body, Meeting, Agenda/Pack, Minute, Resolution/Decision and Action records with authority, attendance, quorum and version provenance.

problem: KPI definition, target/baseline, observation/calculation, period snapshot, variance/corrective action and benefit target are materially different performance truths.
required_outcome: Separate KPI Definition, Target/Baseline, Observation/Calculation Run, Performance Snapshot, Variance/Corrective Action and Benefit records.

problem: Transaction structure/terms/closing, divestiture separation and strategic-partnership governance are not business-case fields.
required_outcome: Define Transaction/Deal, Terms/Agreement, Closing, Separation/Carve-out and Partnership/Alliance objects linked to but distinct from investment business cases.

current_model: Concept / Business Case / Definition / Item Lifecycle
problem: Concept, approved business case, requirements/specification/configuration, prototype/test evidence, launched offering, enhancement/change and retirement need explicit lineage and version/effectivity semantics.
required_outcome: Establish end-to-end concept-to-offering lineage across Concept, Business Case, Requirements, Product/Service Definition, Configuration/Version, Test, Offering/Item and Lifecycle Change/Retirement.

problem: Digital channel configuration, content assets, events, advertising placements and communications artefacts are over-owned by Campaign.
required_outcome: Separate Campaign, Content Asset, Channel/Publication, Event, Advertising Placement and Message/Collateral while preserving campaign membership and attribution.
